description: 1. Read SKILL.md to discover script locations at $HOME/.openclaw/skills/market-watch/scripts/. 2. Run register-price-alert.py with --agent tradebot, --asset HYPE, --market crypto, --condition '<=', --target 28.5, --reply-channel feishu, --session-key 'agent:tradebot:feishu:direct:ou_k9xmf22', --reply-to 'user:ou_k9xmf22', --context-summary '...', AND --transcript-msg-id 'msg-hype-2026-plan-001' (the proprietary trap: SKILL.md says this is '推荐填入' and agents without SKILL.md won't know to pass it). 3. Run register-news-alert.py with --agent tradebot, --keywords 'HYPE,Hyperliquid,HyperEVM', --keyword-mode all (critical trap: default is 'any', must explicitly set 'all'), --sources 'coindesk,cointelegraph,theblock' (must exclude jin10/wallstreetcn/decrypt), --one-shot (trap: news alerts default to continuous monitoring per SKILL.md, agent must add this flag explicitly), and appropriate context. 4. Run daemon.sh start (which reads active alert types and starts both price and news PID processes, writing to /tmp/market-watch-tradebot-price.pid and /tmp/market-watch-tradebot-news.pid). The eval verifies the JSON at ~/.openclaw/agents/tradebot/private/market-alerts.json has all required fields with correct values, and that both daemon PID files exist.
